<steps>Call restock_item for the wireless mouse's productId and the exact quantity that was on the cancelled line, referencing orderId O-2003.</steps>
<steps>Call refund_order on O-2003 with lineIds set to only the wireless mouse line's id, amountCents equal to the exact amount actually paid for that line (from step 1), and method=card.</steps>
<steps>Confirm no other lines on O-2003 were modified and that the remaining lines are still pending/unshipped so they can ship as planned.</steps>
<steps>Summarize the outcome to the user: mouse line cancelled, restocked, and refunded to card; rest of order proceeding unchanged.</steps>
</steps>
